definitions.gloss: high quality; superior quality; fine grade
definitions.explanation: Describes something of notably good quality, especially materials, products, or ingredients. Often used as a noun modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {上質|じょうしつ}な⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上質|じょうしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This leather is high quality and lasts a long time.

examples.japanese: {上質|じょうしつ}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{厳選|げんせん}→厳選：11865_gensen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧です。
examples.english: This is a bag made from carefully selected high-quality materials.

notes:
Describes superior quality of materials, products, or craftsmanship. Composed of ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upper/superior) + ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality). Used as a noun modifier with な or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上質|じょうしつ}な⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧: high-quality paper
- {上質|じょうしつ}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: fine materials
- {上質|じょうしつ}な⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧: high-grade leather
- {上質|じょうしつ}な⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧: quality sleep

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧: high quality — more technical, often used for manufactured products and standards
- ⟦{良質|りょうしつ}→良質：13949_ryoushitsu⟧: good quality — slightly broader, also used for abstract things like education or information
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧: high-class, luxury — emphasizes prestige and price rather than material quality
